commands:
set -euo pipefail
EXPECTED_MAIN=d02bb3537be8a99762bf1264a4691ef06c7879ad
EXPECTED_BRANCH=1ea0c22b6a93a6afc50662364ac0cd61892cb96d
SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J
PACKAGE=pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge
RELAY_BRANCH=chat-relay/orange-chatgpt-pump-v1
git fetch origin main agent/chatgpt-relay-developer-path
test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "$EXPECTED_MAIN"
test "$(git rev-parse origin/agent/chatgpt-relay-developer-path)" = "$EXPECTED_BRANCH"
git checkout -B agent/chatgpt-relay-developer-path origin/agent/chatgpt-relay-developer-path
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
adb devices -l | grep -F "$SERIAL" | grep -F 'device ' | grep -F 'model:SM_S906B'
adb -s "$SERIAL" shell am force-stop "$PACKAGE" || true
adb -s "$SERIAL" shell input keyevent KEYCODE_ENDCALL || true
sleep 1
adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-unmute 0 || true
adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd bluetooth_manager enable || true
for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8; do BT=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell settings get global bluetooth_on 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r' || true); [ "$BT" = 1 ] && break; sleep 0.25; done
echo bluetooth_on=${BT:-unknown}
STATE=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry 2>/dev/null | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9]\).*/\1/p' | head -1 || true)
echo post_cleanup_call_state=${STATE:-unknown}
git push origin --delete "$RELAY_BRANCH" >/tmp/relay-delete.out 2>&1 || true
cat /tmp/relay-delete.out
LEFT=$(git ls-remote --heads origin "refs/heads/$RELAY_BRANCH")
test -z "$LEFT"
echo relay_transient_branch_deleted=true
LLAMA=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell 'pidof llama-server 2>/dev/null || true' | tr -d '\r[:space:]')
echo llama_running=$([ -n "$LLAMA" ] && echo true || echo false)
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
echo failed_relay_cleanup_complete=true
